title: Your brain has its own age.
deck: Risk of Alzheimer's disease, by how old your brain tests

statement.flag: Genes were never the whole story
statement.detail: An old-testing brain carried risk like the strongest Alzheimer's gene. A young one protected like the best — whatever genes you carry.

_provenance.paper: doi:10.1038_s41591-025-03798-1 · Oh et al. 2025, Nat Med · prospective cohort, plasma proteomic organ clocks, UK Biobank n=44,498, 2-17y follow-up
_provenance.axis: Named-organ frame per founder direction 2026-08-22: the viewer owns 'my brain', never 'a count of aged organs'. Three states of one organ — brain tests younger / its age / older — as discrete bars (grow), which is the honest motion for 3 groups. 'Tests its age' = the reference (HR 1.00 by definition, not a reported estimate). 'Older'/'younger' = extreme agers, age-gap z-score beyond ±1.5 (full text, Methods).

claims.quote: having an especially aged brain posed a risk of Alzheimer's disease (hazard ratio (HR) = 3.1) that was similar to carrying one copy of APOE4,
whereas a youthful brain (HR = 0.26) provided protection that was similar to carrying two copies of APOE2, independent of APOE genotype.

_provenance.copy_grounding: Statement's gene sentences ← c1 ('similar to carrying one copy of APOE4, the strongest genetic risk factor for sporadic Alzheimer's disease') and c2 ('similar to carrying two copies of APOE2, independent of APOE genotype'). '3.10×'/'0.26×' print the paper's HRs at uniform 2 decimals.
_provenance.reveal_test: Headline names the premise (your brain has an age) and withholds what that age does; bars arrive youngest-first so 3.10× lands LAST as the payoff, and the statement ('Genes were never the whole story') lands after the chart finishes.
_provenance.cold_read: Every frame line parses one way: deck subject is 'your brain'; bar labels are three states of that one named organ; no derived quantity anywhere (contract #13; count-of-organs frame retired for exactly this).
_provenance.honesty: Bar values are the paper's hazard ratios vs a brain testing its age — 1.00 drawn as the reference bar so 0.26 and 3.10 have a visible yardstick. Alzheimer's endpoint only; the mortality trio (youthful brain/immune/both, HR 0.60/0.58/0.44) is caption material. Association in cohort data; APOE comparisons are the paper's own.
